params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set. Values above 100 return 400 rest_invalid_param.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to posts published after a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to posts published before a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: post
params.description: Limit result set to comments assigned to specific post IDs.

params.name: parent
params.description: Limit result set to comments of specific parent IDs.

items.docs: Lists approved comments. One item exists on this deployment — the default WordPress sample comment attached to the placeholder post. Comment objects carry `author_name`, `author_url` and `author_avatar_urls`, so this collection is personal data even when the single record is boilerplate.
